title: Dengue Protocol for Component Transfers
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required parameters for the protocol, including the volumes for each of the 12 different components that will form the master mix.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the P300 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, Opentrons aluminum blocks, tip rack(s), and the 32 PCR tube strips in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tip rack, aluminum blocks, and the P300 pipette following the app’s calibration workflow.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App. The protocol will transfer the 12 components to create the master mix and then distribute the master mix into the 32 PCR tube strips.
